notes.title: September 12th major update
notes.notes: Now we support 5090, there was a minor bug before. I regret that as a developer, I'm just a small development indie, and I didn't have a 5090 myself, so I couldn't test it properly. Recently, I finally took out a loan to purchase a 5090, and after testing, I've now fixed the issue where 5090 couldn't run normally. I hope everyone enjoys it, and more styles will be updated later.

notes.notes: Fixed the issue that prevented startup on some Windows computers with European encoding.
